contentPattern: Ecosystem logo cards (source 'ecosystem' component). One row per card: cell 1 logo image, cell 2 brand/channel name paragraph + link ('Visit Woolworths', 'Follow Us on LinkedIn'). Used as a single social card on the newsroom and as brand grids on Our brands.
